categories.name: Lifestyle
categories.description: Everyday silhouettes where resale is driven by colourway and cultural heat rather than performance.

categories.name: Basketball
categories.description: On-court heritage models. Historically the deepest resale premiums and the most restock-sensitive.

categories.name: Running
categories.description: Performance and retro-running. Widely distributed, so premiums are thinner but volume is high.

categories.name: Skateboarding
categories.description: Skate tooling. Demand is durable and less correlated with the broader sneaker cycle.

categories.name: Training
categories.description: Cross-training and gym models. Smallest resale segment, largely retail-priced.

categories.name: Trail
categories.description: Technical outdoor footwear. Functional materials create a distinct premium tier.
